code:
for k in ["logreg", "knn",
          "forest", "boost"]:
    plt.plot(range(1, 6), scores[k],
             marker="o", label=k)
plt.xlabel("Fold (same 5 folds)")
plt.ylabel("ROC AUC")
plt.legend()
caption: Plots each model's score on each fold.
Fold 5 is hard for every model, so subtracting fold by fold cancels it out.

code:
rcv = RepeatedStratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=5, n_repeats=3,
    random_state=0)
# forest 0.8957  boost 0.8968
# difference -0.001, forest wins 7/15

caption: A tie: break it on speed, simplicity, and cost.
